# Afsnit 337: Novo Nordisk og Zealand Pharmas kursfald

**Feed**: investeringspodcasten  
**Published**: 2026-09-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this Danish investing podcast (Hansen & Larsen), the hosts review the Q2 C25 earnings season and discuss the risk of a correction in AI stocks ahead of Nvidia's results. They call it a strong season, with about 12 of the 24–25 C25 companies raising guidance. FLSmidth, Vestas, A.P. Møller-Mærsk and Genmab come out on top, while DSV and GN Store Nord are the weakest. Novo Nordisk, Ambu and Royal Unibrew were punished hard despite fairly decent reports.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host has owned it ~1.5 years and is happy; expects 20% swings; results expected to show revenue doubling

#### Reasoning

Host holds the stock long term and is content. Revenue and earnings are expected to double y/y, and guidance visibility is good because two-thirds of the quarter has passed. Near-term price action depends on investor mood, and AI correction risk means 20-40% drawdowns are possible, so the view is hold rather than add.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI-sector correction or turn in investor mood
- results or guidance miss towering expectations

> *"Jag har Nvidia, men det är efterhållande halvannen år sedan jag köpte dem. Så jag är glad och tillfreds."*

---

### 🟢 FLS — FLSmidth | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Top grade 12; 17.3% adjusted EBIT margin; pure mining focus after selling cement; mining upcycle ahead

#### Reasoning

Best report of the season. Margins are possibly at a record after exiting cement, and the hosts expect FLSmidth to ride a global mining wave, which makes the outlook very exciting. The market has already rewarded the stock.

#### Sell Triggers

- mining cycle turns down
- EBIT margin falls back from 17% level

> *"det bästa, Per, det är att de kommer till att rydda på en bölje framöver, InfoMining, för den är där globalt"*

---

### 🟠 VWS — Vestas | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Grade 10; EBIT margin guidance raised 6.8→7.9; 10%+ margin within reach once offshore is profitable

#### Reasoning

The margin upgrade and underlying line items beat analyst expectations. Hosts see the 10%+ long-term EBIT margin milestone coming within reach once offshore wind contributes, and data-center power demand in the US is a tailwind despite political risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- offshore wind stays unprofitable
- onshore or service margins weaken
- US policy blocks projects

> *"så kommer vi rätt tätt på att Vestas kan levera... på de långsiktiga förväntningarna om att få en 10% plus ebit-marknad"*

---

### 🟠 GMAB — Genmab | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Grade 10; good pipeline progress; Phase 3 readouts in Q4 and Q1 2027 with potential blockbusters

#### Reasoning

The upgrade was expected, but pipeline progress impressed the hosts. Upcoming Phase 3 data could produce replacements for the product that loses exclusivity after 2030. The outcome is binary: it all depends on the data.

#### Sell Triggers

- negative Phase 3 data in Q4/Q1 2027

> *"Det handlar om data och inte annat än data."*

---

### 🟡 RBREW — Royal Unibrew | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Sell-off after losing Pepsi to Carlsberg seen as undeserved; host would give management time

#### Reasoning

The Pepsi contract only ends in 2029 and the decision came just 3-4 months ago. Hosts think investors are too harsh and expect a new partner deal or an own-brand product to replace it, so existing holders should be patient.

#### Sell Triggers

- no replacement partnership or product ahead of 2029

> *"om jag var investerare i det här sällskapet, så ger jag bara god tid"*

---

### ⛔ GN — GN Store Nord | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lowest grade (2); fails to deliver growth or earnings after selling the hearing business; investors have left

#### Reasoning

The host thinks selling the hearing business removed the investment case. The remaining enterprise, gaming and defense businesses are not delivering revenue or earnings, and the host's network of investors has sold out. The low valuation alone does not help.

#### Sell Triggers

- remaining businesses start delivering growth and earnings

> *"De har förlatt aktien, för det är inget tillbaka."*

---

### 🟠 DSV — DSV | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Grade 4; slightly weaker delivery, Road division weak; stock down ~500 DKK from top and hasn't recovered

#### Reasoning

The report was not a disaster but fell below DSV's usual standard. Investors who bought on the integration and synergy story were disappointed, and the stock has not recovered while competitors did well. The hosts see the share price as having overshot the operational reality.

#### Sell Triggers

- integration synergies fail to materialise
- Road division keeps weakening

> *"om man länge tittar på aktiekursutvecklingen i DSV i 2026 så kan man få intrycket att DSV har skuffat big time. Och det har de alltså inte."*

---
